tools.name: add_card
tools.description: Add a profile card with optional emoji and cover illustration. Max 6 cards. When adding a card, generate a simple, elegant SVG illustration (400x200 viewBox) that represents the card topic. Use soft, muted colors. Keep it minimal — abstract shapes, simple icons, or geometric patterns work best.

emoji.description: Emoji icon for the card (e.g. 🚀, 🎨). Required.

svg.description: SVG illustration for the card cover. Required. Must be a valid SVG string with viewBox="0 0 400 200". Use soft, warm colors that match the SellMyself palette (#1a1714, #faf8f5, #f2efeb, #ddd9d3, #9c9590, #4a4440). Keep it simple and elegant — abstract shapes, simple line art, or geometric patterns.

tools.name: remove_card
tools.description: Remove a profile card by its index (0-based)

index.description: Index of the card to remove (0-based)

tools.name: update_card
tools.description: Update an existing card's title, description, emoji, and/or cover illustration by index (0-based). When updating, you can generate a new SVG illustration that matches the card content.

index.description: Index of the card to update (0-based)

title.description: New title (leave empty to keep current)

description.description: New description (leave empty to keep current)

imageUrl.description: Cover image URL for the card

svg.description: SVG illustration for the card cover. Must be a valid SVG string with viewBox="0 0 400 200". Use soft, warm colors matching the SellMyself palette. Overrides imageUrl if both provided.

tools.name: set_avatar
tools.description:
Generate and set a line-art SVG avatar for the user's profile. IMPORTANT: You MUST generate a custom SVG based on the user's characteristics. Follow this exact style:
- viewBox: 0 0 200 200
- Background: <rect fill="#faf8f5" width="200" height="200"/>
- All drawing in a <g> with: fill="none" stroke="#1a1714" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
- 3/4 view (face center at ~cx=103): head slightly turned right
- Head: <ellipse cx="103" cy="108" rx="38" ry="44"/> (face outline)
- Neck/shoulders: two short paths going down from ~y=140 to y=170
- Eyes: small filled circles (r=2, fill="#1a1714" stroke="none"), left eye cx≈90, right eye cx≈114
- Nose: short diagonal line around (105,115)→(108,120)
- Mouth: subtle curve path around y=128-132
- Hair: customize based on user (short/long/curly/straight/bangs/ponytail/bun/buzz). Hair is stroke-only lines and paths.
- Optional: glasses (two small circle/rect outlines), earrings, hat, beard, freckles, blush lines
- Keep it MINIMAL — only #1a1714 strokes on #faf8f5 background. No fills except eye dots.
- Customize hair style, accessories, and expression to match the user's personality.

Reference SVG (short bob hair): <svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect fill="#faf8f5" width="200" height="200"/><g fill="none" stroke="#1a1714" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M88 170 Q88 150 92 140"/><path d="M120 170 Q118 150 115 140"/><ellipse cx="103" cy="108" rx="38" ry="44"/><path d="M68 95 Q65 55 103 50 Q142 55 140 95"/><path d="M65 88 Q58 120 68 138"/><path d="M140 88 Q145 110 138 125"/><circle cx="90" cy="105" r="2" fill="#1a1714" stroke="none"/><circle cx="114" cy="103" r="2" fill="#1a1714" stroke="none"/><path d="M105 115 L108 120"/><path d="M95 128 Q103 133 111 128"/></g></svg>

svg.description: Custom line-art SVG avatar. MUST follow the style guide above. viewBox="0 0 200 200", #faf8f5 background, #1a1714 strokes only, 3/4 view face.
